LSA art. 23 para. 1 requires the employer to give each worker an itemised statement of how each wage item is calculated (工資各項目計算方式明細). LSA Enforcement Rules art. 14-1 sets the minimum content: (1) total wage agreed by employer and employee; (2) amount of each wage item; (3) amounts deducted under law or agreement; (4) amount actually paid. Breach of art. 23: fine of NT$20,000 to NT$1,000,000 (LSA art. 79).
